integrity: Analytical proof uses classical finite-geometric sums and standard quadratic Gauss sums; Python numerical checks are supplementary, and earlier inaccessible specialist literature remains a novelty risk.
limitations: Prime length only, one fully erased coordinate, standard root chirps; unnormalized periodic rather than aperiodic autocorrelation; no optimality among arbitrary phase families or multi-erasure masks.
title: Quadratic-nonresidue optimality for one-erasure prime cyclic chirps
